mapper.select: SELECT start_time, end_time, status FROM reservation WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN (0, 1) AND start_time < #{endTime} AND end_time > #{startTime} ORDER BY start_time, end_time, id LIMIT 201
SELECT id FROM `user` WHERE id = #{studentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id FROM reservation r JOIN equipment e ON e.id = r.equipment_id WHERE e.lab_id = #{labId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status IN (0, 1) AND r.end_time > #{now} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.id FROM equipment e WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.id > #{afterId} AND ( (e.status = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservation r WHERE r.equipment_id = e.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND r.end_time <= #{now}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservation r WHERE r.equipment_id = e.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND r.end_time > #{now})) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usage_log u JOIN reservation r ON r.id = u.reservation_id WHERE r.equipment_id = e.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.end_time IS NULL AND r.end_time <= #{now}) ) ORDER BY e.id LIMIT #{limit}
